story.title: Mukta Patil didn't set out to become a nutritionist. She became one because she had to.
paragraphs: Eat Rrite began from a personal health crisis — postpartum weight gain, crash diets, and body-shaming that failed her.
Eight years on, the mission remains unchanged - To help people embrace the magic of Eat Rrite

doctors.title: A physician alongside nutrition — when reports need more than food.
doctors.lead: Eat Rrite works with a general physician so plans stay aligned with your medical care. If something sits outside nutrition, a doctor is already on the team.

mission.title: Mission, vision, and the way we work

cards.title: Mission
cards.text: Reach 1000+ women and help them heal — in mind, body and soul — with nutrition as the foundation.
cards.imageAlt: Woman practising yoga, strength and healing

cards.title: Vision
cards.text: Help the world learn to Eat Rrite and discover the magic of what a well-nourished body can achieve.
cards.imageAlt: Colourful nourishing bowl of fresh food

cards.title: Approach
cards.text:
To listen without judgement
To heal with empathy first
To treat everyone and every symptom with a tailor made approach - no generalisation, ever!
